tier_reason: REPORT.md (in Chinese) runs the public benchmark code in benchmarks/pipeline_comparison/ (protobuf_zmq_pipeline.cc, mino_shm_pipeline.cc, mino_tcp_pipeline.cc, pipeline_comparison_runner.py, pipeline_network_runner.py) head-to-head against Protobuf+ZeroMQ, Fast DDS and Cyclone DDS. It gives only a KVM guest with 8 vCPU and no CPU model, and does not pin the compiler for the pipeline build, so it falls short of A. These are first-party numbers from 2 rounds, which makes them C.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: bazel build --config=pipeline_comparison -c opt --jobs=4 (Bazel 7.4.1 via bazelisk 1.29.0; .bazelrc adds -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-omit-frame-pointer globally). The host toolchain is not named for the pipeline build; the same report says Debian 13's g++-14 ran the host sanity tests.
corrections.caveats: The benchmark was designed, run and reported by the same solo author, so it is not independent. The physical CPU model is not disclosed, only a KVM guest with 8 vCPU and 15.64 GiB RAM, which falls short of full Tier A methodology. Saturation mode (publish-interval 0) means the percentiles include queuing delay, not idle one-hop latency. The baseline is Protobuf serialization over ZeroMQ ipc:// sockets at every hop, while Mino SHM transfers zero-copy handles to a generated typed frame and Mino TCP uses its own canonical wire codec. Part of the gap may therefore come from serialization and copying rather than transport alone. Only 2 rounds were run. The 12x network smoke figure comes from a single 50-message run, and buffering parameters (ZMQ HWM vs Mino SPSC capacity 64) are not semantically identical, as the README itself notes.

notes: All claimed figures check out against the page. Small p50 means: Mino 1814.5us vs ZMQ 10556us (5.8x). Medium: 979us vs 1973us (about 2x). Large: 13718us vs 26850.5us (about 1.96x). Network smoke: 855us vs 10.33ms (about 12x). Fast DDS medium throughput of 3571 msgs/s vs Mino's 2925 also matches. Metadata matches gh: LGPL-3.0, 2 stars, not a fork, not archived, last commit 2026-09-13, created 2026-07-26.
